messages:
Priya: Quick note from today's cloud marketplace call  procurement wants one clear doc that explains: private-offer pricing, any HW surcharge, how SI credits apply, and what happens at renewal/ET. Can we nail a short playbook here?
Gabe: Yes. Two sticky items: appliance surcharge (hardware hosting) and co-marketing credits that partners want to stack. Both affect effective price and ARR math.
Yvonne: Proposal: keep three levers visible on private-offer: (1) Commit discount, (2) SI success payment, (3) Appliance surcharge (if customer uses on-prem appliance). Show math in example.
Caleb: Example table (simplified):
```
Commit = $500k/yr
List discount = 16% -> discounted commit = $420k
Appliance surcharge = +5% ($21k) if on-prem appliance selected
SI success = $20k payable at 90d on SLOs
Net effective spend = $420k + $21k + $20k = $461k (payment timing differs)
```
Gabe: Important: call appliance fee a "deployment surcharge" applied only when the private-offer includes the appliance SKU. Avoid language like "hardware tax."
Yvonne: Renewal/ET rules: if customer terminates early, smoothing credits are pro-rated and any unused SI success reserves are void unless remediation plan executed. Also add an "early-renew" incentive: renew >60 days early -> one-time 2.5% renewal credit applied to new term.
Priya: Procurement will ask about stacking: default = no stacking with marketplace promos. Co-marketing credits are separate and paid to partner after joint case study is published (30-90 day window). Must be explicitly included in private-offer attachment to stack.
Caleb: Ops req: marketplace metering parity. Any private-offer listing must include a meter ID that maps to our internal meter. Dispute window = 45 days from monthly statement.
Gabe: Finance note: appliance surcharge is recognized on delivery; commit discounts + smoothing credits affect deferred revenue. We should add a 1-liner for RevOps/Finance and include example GAAP-friendly language for the contract.
Yvonne: Draft clause for SI success: "SI success payment is conditional on documented onboarding SLOs (availability, usage > X, feature checklist) and invoiced upon sign-off by CSM within 10 business days of milestone completion."
Priya: Announcement cadence: don't publish private-offer until appliance SKU images + SI toolkit are live. Proposed timeline: 10 days post-close for joint announcement, 21 days post-close for marketplace private-offer listing (to allow AP/ops wiring).
Caleb: Partner escalation: add contact matrix in private-offer attachment: Partner AE -> Redwood Partner Ops -> RevOps -> Legal. Attach SLA: partner ops responds within 2 business days for billing recon issues.
Gabe: One more: include a short procurement-facing FAQ with 3 scenarios (appliance + low usage, cloud-only fast ramp, partial SI adoption). Priya to own.
Priya: I'll draft the single-page playbook + FAQ + spreadsheet with the 3 scenarios. Will share by Tue EOD.
partner-bot: Created task: marketplace-appliance-surcharge-playbook -> owner: Priya, due_in: 3 business days (task id: MP-2026-78).
Yvonne: I'll draft the SI success language and the early-renew incentive bullets.
Caleb: I'll coordinate with RevOps on meter ID field and the accounting paragraph.
Gabe: Loop in Legal on the ET language. If anyone wants to see a sample cap table of discounts vs ARR, ping me.
Priya: Thanks all, short and actionable. We'll reconvene after the draft. :thumbsup:
